summary: Tested the self-hosted auth migration (bcrypt + HS256 JWT) end to end. Backend: 26 pytest cases in test_local_auth_migration.py. 22 passed and 4 failed (one more failed with a transient 502 in the parallel run and passed serially). Covered phone and email register, password login, OTP login, reset, change-by-old, legacy lazy migration, admin 2FA, ban/unban/reset/create-test and IP/region. Frontend: phone password login, refresh persistence, /account, logout, phone register via UI, email OTP login, admin login + TOTP -> dashboard, and the 用户列表 'IP / 地區' column all work.

critical.issue: SECURITY: both return the raw users doc (**u), which includes password_hash (bcrypt) for every member, and token_ver too. Confirmed: 16 rows leaked in the list, and the detail for user_993de66017fb213aee3ef136 leaked it as well. Strip password_hash (and token_ver) from both responses.

Returns 500. q is used unescaped in $regex for email/phone/name/user_id/profile.name. A leading '+' gives pymongo OperationFailure 'quantifier does not follow a repeatable item'. Searching by E.164 phone breaks, and any regex metacharacter can cause a 500 or a ReDoS. Use re.escape(q) for all fields, as is already done for last_ip.

minor.issue: Ban also bumps token_ver, so the banned user's existing token gets 401 '登入已失效' on /api/me, not 403 '帳號已被停用' as the spec says. Password-login does return 403 correctly. Decide which is intended. The 403 branch in require_user can never be reached for tokens issued before the ban.

AUTH_SECRET is not in backend/.env (only its presence was checked, count=0), so JWTs and admin tokens are signed with CLERK_SECRET_KEY. If that key is removed when Clerk is retired, every session and OTP hash breaks, and the lazy migration also stops. Add a dedicated AUTH_SECRET.
No brute-force throttling for members. Admin login has _fail_guard, but member password login does not.

Trusts the first X-Forwarded-For value sent by the client. A test request with XFF 113.108.0.1 was stored as last_ip with region 中国 广东 广州市, so a user can fake their IP and region. The admin IP fail-guard can also be bypassed by rotating XFF.
Do not bump token_ver, so other sessions stay valid after a password change. Reset-password does bump it.
Return ok:true for a uid that does not exist (no 404).
One transient 502 from Cloudflare/ingress during the parallel pytest run (test_phone_otp_login). It passed when run serially.

issues: Column header 'IP / 地區' is not converted in the ZH-CN locale (shows 地區 while the other headers are simplified). The i18n entry is missing.

action_items: Remove password_hash (and token_ver) from /api/admin/members list and detail responses
Use re.escape(q) for every $regex in admin_members (phone search with '+' currently returns 500)
Add a dedicated AUTH_SECRET env var instead of falling back to CLERK_SECRET_KEY
Decide on the ban semantics: keep token_ver bump (401) or return 403 as the spec says
Optional: rate-limit member password-login; only trust XFF set by the proxy; bump token_ver on password change
critical_code_review_comments: admin_api.py is about 2230 lines; split it by domain
has_password() calls the Clerk API on every /api/auth/me for legacy users without a password_hash key; cache the result
OTP verify endpoints (/verify, /phone/verify) do not check banned before issuing a token (require_user still blocks it later)
admin TOTP codes can be replayed within the valid window (no last-used counter stored)
seed_data_creation: Created about 15 test users (phones +1201555xxxxx, emails qa*/otp*/rst*/qa-test*+clerk_test@shop.com, and one phone account registered via the UI). Nothing was deleted. The legacy tester+clerk_test@shop.com is now migrated (password_hash set). +12015556760's password was not changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=... pytest tests/test_local_auth_migration.py (pytest.ini adds xdist; use -n 0 for serial). The 4 expected failures: password_hash leak (x2), the + phone search 500, and test_banned_token_gets_403 (spec 403 vs actual 401). UI is ZH-CN by default, so text checks must use simplified characters (e.g. 我的帐户/帐户ID). Admin members is the sidebar tab '用户列表', not a /members route.
